caseNameFull: Walker, Postmaster General v. Esquire, Inc.
attorneys: Hannegan substituted as the party-petitioner., Acting Solicitor General Judson for petitioner. Messrs. Bruce Bromley, Wm. Dwight Whitney and Morris L. Ernst for respondent., Messrs. Charles Horsky, Luther Ely Smith, Arthur Garfield Hays and Whitney North Seymour filed a brief on behalf of the American Civil Liberties Union, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia granted.
